sources.title: Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins in Manufacturing
sources.titleEn: Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins in Manufacturing
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 製造執行系統整合
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：特徵可由原波形重算，異常與故障分開，沒有把合成閾值當現場標準。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Features reproduce from raw data, anomaly and fault remain distinct, and synthetic thresholds are not field standards.
related.difference: 用工作訂單、工件與事件識別碼區分新完工、重送及更正，避免重複計產。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish new completions, retries and corrections using order, part and eventIDs to avoid duplicate production counts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RMS=√(Σxi²/N)描述能量尺度，峰值因子=max|xi|/RMS；必須固定取樣與頻帶才能比較。 純合成示例速度樣本[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s，四點只供算式教學，不足作頻譜診斷。 RMS=√(10/4)=1.58114 mm/s，峰值2 mm/s，峰值因子1.26491。
可重送訊息不等於可重複計數；以事件ID去重、以工件狀態機限制合法轉移，保存更正歷史。 合成100件唯一完工，97良品、3報廢；網路重送5筆良品事件，原始訊息共105筆。 去重良率97/100=97%；直接計訊息為102/105=97.1429%，且虛增5件。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RMS=√(Σ xi²/N) measures signal scale and crest factor=max|xi|/RMS; comparisons need common sampling and bandwidth. Synthetic velocity samples[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s; four points teach arithmetic, not spectral diagnosis. RMS=1.58114 mm/s, peak 2 mm/s and crest factor 1.26491.

Retryable messages are not repeatable counts; deduplicate by eventID, enforce part-state transitions and retain correction history. Synthetic 100 unique completions,97 good and 3 scrap; five good-event retries produce 105 raw messages. Deduplicated yield 97%; naive message counting gives 102/105=97.1429% and five fictitious parts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: KUKA KR QUANTEC 工業手臂
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：特徵可由原波形重算，異常與故障分開，沒有把合成閾值當現場標準。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Features reproduce from raw data, anomaly and fault remain distinct, and synthetic thresholds are not field standards.
related.difference: 以末端彎矩檢查負載表，而不只檢查公斤數。
related.differenceEn: Check wrist bending moment rather than payload mass alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RMS=√(Σxi²/N)描述能量尺度，峰值因子=max|xi|/RMS；必須固定取樣與頻帶才能比較。 純合成示例速度樣本[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s，四點只供算式教學，不足作頻譜診斷。 RMS=√(10/4)=1.58114 mm/s，峰值2 mm/s，峰值因子1.26491。
同方向重力彎矩相加 M=Σmigr，質量與偏置共同決定負荷。；教學工件 20 kg 偏置 0.35 m，工具 5 kg 偏置 0.10 m。；M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RMS=√(Σ xi²/N) measures signal scale and crest factor=max|xi|/RMS; comparisons need common sampling and bandwidth. Synthetic velocity samples[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s; four points teach arithmetic, not spectral diagnosis. RMS=1.58114 mm/s, peak 2 mm/s and crest factor 1.26491.
Aligned gravity moments add as M=Σmigr; both mass and offset determine loading.; Teaching workpiece: 20 kg at 0.35 m; tool: 5 kg at 0.10 m.; M=(20×0.35+5×0.10)×9.81=73.575 N·m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
